result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontal carousels in 'Fastest near you' and the category filter row clip content at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance, and the promo banner text has borderline contrast on the green background.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') mid-word at the right screen edge with no visible scroll indicator or peek padding, making it unclear that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a partial-card peek plus a subtle scroll hint (e.g., gradient fade or chevron) so users understand the row scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, lacking a clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Provide a slight peek of the next chip and/or a fade-out gradient on the right edge to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' on the green promo banner uses a lighter green/white tone that may fall below the recommended 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text color contrast (e.g., pure white or a lighter tint) against the green background to meet WCAG AA for small text.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis-aware layout in the visible card, reducing readability of the listing title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated titles use a proper ellipsis and consider a two-line clamp or smaller font so names remain legible in carousel cards.
